features.name: Magus at Arms
features.body: Gain Proficiencies in all Spell Foci, and Proficiency in Light armour. At Magus Level 3 gain Expertise in Staves.

features.name: Critical Spells
features.body: When casting a spell that doesn’t require an Attack roll, roll a **d20**. Regardless of the outcome, the spell’s effect does not normally change, however if you roll a **Nat 20** the spell **crits**, its damage is doubled and enemies effected by the spell fail any relevant Save. This d20 roll is affected by your Crit Chance with spells, so if you have +2 to Crit Chance, spells crit on an 18 or higher.

features.name: Expansive Casting
features.body:
Increase the **range** of all spells by **+2m**. This is increased by an additional **+2m** at Magus Levels 4, 6, 8, and 10.

Categorize AoE spells in 2 categories, **Small** and **Large**. Small spells have an circular radius 3m or less, diameter 6m or less, a rectangular area less than 25m, a cone with no dimension greater than 4m, etc. Large spells are anything larger. *All Small spells gain +1m to their radius, or +2m to their diameter, or +1m in length and width. All Large spells gain +2m to their radius, +4 to their diameter, or +2m in length and width*. Small spells gain additional **+1m** to all sizes (+2 for diameter) at Magus Levels **5** and **8**. Large spells gain additional **+2m** (+4 diameter) at the same levels.

features.name: Charge Regulation
features.body: When you cast a spell, if that spell requires or utilizes **Charges** in any way, modify the amount of Charges used. If a spell or spell effect requires a certain number of Charges, it requires **1 less**. If a spell gains bonuses or additional effects from a certain number of Charges consumed, act as if you consumed **+1** additional Charge.

features.name: Charge Infusion
features.body: Once per turn if an effect would cause you to gain **Charges**, spend **2 Mana** to gain **+1** additional Charges. At Player Levels 7, 11, 15, and 19 the maximum of Charges can you gain is increased by +1, but costs 2 Mana per charge. You may choose less than the maximum.
